ADM: A machine that can be used in place of HMs. It also mines underwater or in the KBT Expressway.
Baby Monitor: A device used to check on the status of Pokémon at the Route 5 Pokémon Day Care.
Blunder Policy: Sharply raises Speed when the holder's move misses because of accuracy.
Braille Converter: A device used to read an ancient dialect known as “Braille.” It has not been spoken in over 1000 years.
Candy Sweet: A sweet candy sold in Fallshore City.
Catching Charm: Holding it is said to increase the chance of getting a critical catch. Curiously, it doesn’t shake much.
Costume Box: A convenient container for storing outfits. Use it to change clothes, as well as certain colors.
DexNav: An upgraded version of the Pokedex that makes encountering specific Wild Pokémon easier.
Dream Mist: A mist that brings on dreams.
Frontier Card: A card that lists the battle points you have earned and battle facility prints you have received.
Galarica Wreath: A wreath of Galarian design that a Pokémon can hold.
Hisui Rock: A rock from the Hisui region.
Link Stone: A stone that some Pokémon use to evolve.
Max Powder: A powder that a Pokémon can hold.
Mega Keystone: A stone which enables Pokémon holding a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.
Motorcycle: A motorbike with pedals that allows faster movement than the Running Shoes.
Notebook: A notebook containing research on Pokémon moves. Inside it’s marked “Property of Prof. Log’s Aide”.
Porta-PC: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won’t work.
Silvally Memory: A memory disc that changes the type of Silvally and its Multi-Attack.
Stat Scanner: A device used to view the hidden stats and movesets of Pokémon. It is not for the average Trainer.
Time Turner: A strange device that lets you distort the fabric of time. AM times become PM times and vice versa.
Trainer Catalogue: A device used to find trainers eager for battle in Borrius. It also keeps a record of their teams.
Utility Umbrella: Protects the holder from the effects of sun and rain.
Zygarde Cell: A cell of the Zygarde Pokémon.
